Example Model in Multiple Formats

Source: R/data-example_models.R
example_models.Rd

An example energy system model in several optimization modeling languages (GAMS, GMPL, JuMP/Julia), along with its parsed multimod representation. Used for testing and validating multimod's parsers and conversion functions.

Usage

example_models

Format

A list with 1 element:

energyRt

energyRt TOPIA test case with components:

gams

List with model: energyRt's GAMS template source (gams/energyRt.gms) as a character vector, ready for read_gams(include = FALSE)

multimod

Parsed multimod model object with energyRt data attached

metadata

List with source, scenario, repository, license, energyRt_version, gams_source, date_imported, note

Source

  • energyRt: https://github.com/energyRt/energyRt

Details

Structure

The example contains:

  • Source code in several formats (character vectors, ready to parse)

  • Parsed multimod object (already converted, ready to use)

  • Metadata about the source, license, and provenance

All source code character vectors can be used directly with read_gams(), read_gmpl(), etc. without writing temporary files.

energyRt Test Case

The energyRt package is an R-based energy systems modeling framework. The TOPIA R7 kit is a small 7-region, multi-timeslice test case used for validation.

The model structure is parsed from energyRt's GAMS template with read_gams(include = FALSE); GAMS is the source of truth because the GMPL/JuMP/Pyomo templates are still evolving. The data is attached from an interpolated energyRt scenario. See data-raw/build_energyRt_fixture.R.

License: Apache License 2.0, the same license as multimod itself. See LICENSE.note.

Usage

data(example_models)

energyRt_gams  <- example_models$energyRt$gams$model
energyRt_model <- example_models$energyRt$multimod

References

energyRt package: https://github.com/energyRt/energyRt

See also

  • read_gams for parsing GAMS models

  • read_gmpl for parsing GMPL models

  • as_multimod for converting model structures to multimod

Examples

# Load examples
data(example_models)

# Inspect structure
names(example_models)
#> [1] "energyRt"
names(example_models$energyRt)
#> [1] "gams"     "multimod" "metadata"

# Check metadata
example_models$energyRt$metadata
#> $source
#> [1] "energyRt TOPIA kit"
#> 
#> $scenario
#> [1] "R7 / topia_seasons / base horizon"
#> 
#> $repository
#> [1] "https://github.com/optimal2050/energyRt"
#> 
#> $license
#> [1] "Apache-2.0"
#> 
#> $energyRt_version
#> [1] "0.90.0.9012"
#> 
#> $gams_source
#> [1] "gams/energyRt.gms"
#> 
#> $date_imported
#> [1] "2026-10-04"
#> 
#> $note
#> [1] "Model structure parsed from energyRt's GAMS template with read_gams(include = FALSE); data attached from an interpolated energyRt scenario. See data-raw/build_energyRt_fixture.R."
#> 

# Use the pre-parsed multimod model
summary(example_models$energyRt$multimod)
#>               Length Class  Mode     
#> name            0    -none- NULL     
#> desc            0    -none- NULL     
#> sets           27    -none- list     
#> aliases         7    -none- list     
#> mappings      324    -none- list     
#> parameters    218    -none- list     
#> variables      93    -none- list     
#> equations     153    -none- list     
#> inMemory        1    -none- logical  
#> base_path       0    -none- NULL     
#> metadata        2    -none- list     
#> objectives      1    -none- list     
#> index_aliases  44    -none- character
#> misc            2    -none- list     

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Parse from source (no temp files needed)
model_gams <- read_gams(
  file_or_text = example_models$energyRt$gams$model,
  include = FALSE
)

# Export to different formats
write_gmpl(example_models$energyRt$multimod, "tmp/energyrt")
write_pyomo(example_models$energyRt$multimod, "tmp/energyrt_pyomo")
} # }
